errors.evidence: The description states that the second line (after gate) starts at approximately 1.0 and decreases, but it actually starts around 0.93.
The description states that the first line (before gate) starts at approximately 0.18, but it actually starts near 0.32.
The description states that the first line (before gate) reaches approximately 0.00–0.01 at the last layers, but it actually levels off around 0.02.
The description incorrectly states that the green line (after average gate) starts near 0.95, while it actually starts closer to 0.62.
The description omits mention of the horizontal trend in the first line after layer 8, where it levels off at around 0.02.
The description does not mention the specific average values noted in the legend for each line.
Description states the blue dashed line starts near 0.18 at layer 0, but figure shows it starts near 1.0.
Description states the blue dashed line ends near 0.01 at layer 23, but figure shows it ends near 0.0.
Description states the orange dotted line ends around 0.40 at layer 23, but figure shows it fluctuates around 0.05–0.15.
Description states the green dash-dot line fluctuates at lower values around 0.08–0.12 from layer 13 through layer 20, but figure shows it fluctuates below 0.05 for many of those layers.
Description does not mention the existence of the second figure showing sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying average gating score, which is relevant context.
Vague phrasing in statements like 'the orange dotted line decreases in a generally downward trend' could be clearer regarding specific data points.
Description says the blue dashed line represents sparsity ratio before gating with an average of 0.03, while the figure shows it approximately 0.18.
Description states the orange dotted line represents the sparsity ratio after gating with an average of 0.44, but the figure shows it is about 0.47 around layer 9.
Description claims the green dash-dot line fluctuates between roughly 0.05 and 0.15 from layers 12 through 20, while the figure shows the values are actually lower, close to 0.0.
Description states 'sparsity ratio before gate averages 0.03' but it averages 0.19 in the figure.
Description states 'sparsity ratio after gate averages 0.44' but it averages around 0.28.
Description states 'sparsity ratio after average gate averages 0.33' but it averages closer to 0.10.
The description does not mention the increasing trend observed in the sparsity ratio after gate between Layer 22 and Layer 23.
The description uses 'steep' and 'relatively constant' which could be clearer in defining the rate of change.
